repos_data.description: MCP-native pay-per-tool-call micropayments for AI agents (Solana + USDC + x402)
Connect any MCP client to the MeshTool platform + MeshMarket exchange in 30 seconds — agents that remember, reason, and rent each other's tools.
MCP server for Botwallet — Give any AI agent a wallet via Model Context Protocol. FROST threshold signing, x402 paid APIs, spending guard rails.
MCP server for agentic payments on Solana: pay x402 paywalls, datasets and checkouts behind hard spending caps
TypeScript SDK for agent spend governance around paid tool calls across MCP, LangGraph, OpenAI, Claude, and Gemini: spend authorization, evidence receipts, refunds, disputes, and settlement.
Pay-per-call x402 gateway for AI agents — MCP server + OpenAI-compatible API for agent tools, market data, RPC, and MCP security audits. Pay in USDC on Base, no account.
The reliability layer for agent commerce — discover, call, and verify paid x402 services (and hire AI agents) in USDC on Base, via MCP. Client-observed reliability evidence; no escrow, no token.
Live data for AI agents — search, research, markets, crypto, X/Twitter. Pay-per-call via x402 micropayments.

MCP server (+ OpenClaw SKILL.md) that gives AI agents access to real-world people who listed themselves to be hired by agents. Search by skill/location/equipment, Post job offers & jobboard listings. Free tier / Pro subscription / x402 pay-per-use. Payments default to crypto (USDC) + other crypto + fiat supported.
Install one middleware. Monetize unused 402 responses with recommendations, discovery, and machine commerce analytics.
Agent-native global eSIM over MCP — an AI agent buys one eSIM for 193 countries, anonymously, per-MB in USDT/USDC crypto, and earns 20% referral forever. Claude/Cursor/Continue + any MCP client.
MCP server for Shieldz, the non-custodial crypto payment gateway. AI agents create invoices and accept crypto payments with $0 platform fees.
